topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 56 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 12 ERC20 tokens, 11 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 11 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc721holder, proxy, erc1967upgrade). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
